intro: Your bedroom should feel like a retreat, and Irene makes that easy. Its plush cushioned headboard and spacious storage turn your bedroom into a peaceful haven—where stress fades and comfort takes over.

features.title: Sleek minimalism with a modern touch
features.text: The clean lines and sleek finish reflect contemporary elegance, effortlessly elevating your bedroom’s ambiance while offering a timeless look.

features.title: Upholstered headboard for comfort
features.text: Lean back and relax. The soft, cushioned headboard provides luxurious support, making it perfect for reading or unwinding after a long day.

features.title: Box storage with easy handles
features.text: Life gets busy, but staying organised shouldn’t be hard. The hidden box storage, designed with easy-lift handles, keeps your essentials within reach—without the mess.

features.title: Engineered wood for durability
features.text: Crafted from durable engineered wood, Irene isn’t just about beauty—it’s made to last, supporting restful nights and peaceful mornings for years to come.

features.title: Low maintenance for hassle-free living
features.text: With its smooth surfaces and durable materials, the bed is easy to clean and maintain, letting you enjoy a tidy and stress-free space.

name: Irene King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
